Excellent Japanese food in a quite place
Oct 2019 • Family
Authentic and really tasty food, owned by a Japanese. They have a very nice little garden and the indoor area is calm and cozy. The place is quite small, I had the feeling I was eating in the house of a Japanese friend. We tried about 8 different dishes and they were all very good, with the exception of the Shanghai ramen that was a bit too salty for our taste. The eggplant with miso was one of my favorite (small plate but excellent). Service was good too with friendly waiters. We will return there.

Good for lunch or coffee!
Oct 2019 • Couples
If you hanker for a bite to eat, a quiet place to fit and read or coffee with a friend this might be the perfect spot. Lunch, authentic Japanese style, can be had here for 50,000 vnd to 100,000 vnd. I’d pay that just to relax here over a cup of tea for a couple of hours. 

Service, food and atmosphere are all great. The flavors are authentic, though the meat is a little on the tough side. I’d give 4.5 stars if I could but since it’s such a special place I’ve bumped it up to five. The Japanese language school next door intrigued me, also. I spoke to the staff in Zhao’s EdD and found that some of them speak rather well.

Very authentic Japanese style food with appropriately authentic Japanese serving dishes. Sat by a fully maintained Koi pond and had a romantic "breakfast" (we basically ordered dinner). Made it to our train twenty minutes early and happy and full. Would absolutely recommend this place to anyone.
